results.condition: Build and verify a polished Three.js first-person shooter prototype in the existing project, using a suitable Sketchfab/GLB asset with attribution, and complete the required builder/critic/verifier child-session loop plus remediation and re-verification.
results.evidence:
Summary: Nightshift is built and pushed: a Three.js neon-industrial FPS prototype with pointer-lock movement, shooting, waves, reloads, health/score HUD, mobile layout, and an attributed Sketchfab GLB. Distinct builder, critic, verifier, remediation, and final-verifier sessions were launched. The critic's empty-grid finding and verifier's selector/reload/mobile findings were remediated. Build, GLB validation, and post-remediation Chromium smoke checks passed.
Criterion: Playable FPS | Evidence: src/main.js, index.html, and src/style.css implement the game loop, controls, combat, HUD, and responsive presentation.
Criterion: Asset workflow | Evidence: GLTFLoader integrates sci-fi-crate-normalized.glb; sidecar attributes starkerg, UID 23af43363ba84509ae7ab7a1ff1580c4, CC Attribution. Inspection: 19 meshes, 4,064 faces, 5 materials, one embedded 512px texture.
Criterion: Orchestration | Evidence: Builder ses_fb991063dffebOd6qh0r67jIg6d6, critic ses_fb98d19f7ffeE4IwGaKpS2Le6t, verifier ses_fb98d19d8ffecjnljCAvAQUVh0, remediation ses_fb98a8f9cffeE3Y8OSyjdshLDb, runtime fix ses_fb987de6fffeDkRUqbTAgPBYZW, final verifier ses_fb98506abffed7UXsaIngEtuS0.
Criterion: Delivery | Evidence: npm run build, GLB validation, git diff --check, and post-remediation Chromium smoke passed. Commits 0020e16 and e75eece pushed to opencode/33139219006.
Check: npm run build | passed | exit 0
Check: git diff --check | passed | exit 0
Check: GLB inspection and validation | passed | exit 0
Check: Post-remediation Chromium smoke | passed | exit 0
Changed files: README.md, index.html, package.json, package-lock.json, public/models, src/main.js, src/style.css, screenshots
Known limitations: This is a polished prototype, not literal Call of Duty AAA parity.; Final verifier was launched but returned no separate report before the time budget; remediation smoke evidence passed.; Pointer lock is browser-policy dependent and Vite reports a bundle-size warning.
